NOTE (not a bug) - When running full pytest with default -n 2 xdist workers, test_backend_api.py TestAuth/TestBarcode/TestSales fail with 401 because parallel workers share the same session fixtures in an unsafe way. Running serially (-n 0) resolves all these. Consider adding proper session isolation or class-level fixtures to that legacy test file. This is a test-infra issue, not an app bug.
